question: GQ-006
subject: vaulted passage index — first audit-verifiable check since it was copied

content_spot_checks.sample: 9|31|423|I am loathe to close. We are not enemies

root_cause_correction.wrong: I said mode=ro fails on the vault because the external volume refuses WAL/shm sidecars.
root_cause_correction.right: Too broad. The vaulted passage index opens fine with mode=ro. The discriminator is the SQLite header write_version: passages.sqlite is 1 (rollback journal) and opens either way; the bifrost snapshot is 2 (WAL) and needs immutable=1 because a read-only open still wants to create a -shm file.
root_cause_correction.how_found: Read bytes 18-19 of both file headers instead of theorising about the filesystem.

not_done: Full-table checksum. A sum(chars),sum(words) scan over 41.5M rows across USB timed out at 10 minutes. Three fixed-rowid spot checks at first, middle and last are what was actually verified — that is weaker than a checksum and is reported as such, not rounded up to 'verified identical'.
derivation_declined: No derivation is declared for the vault row count. `select count(*) from passage` over 41.5M rows on USB takes 2m+ per call, and the audit runs on every verify and a dozen times inside the gate self-test — declaring it made the chain unusable. Measured here once, with the timing recorded, rather than re-run on every gate invocation. A gate slow enough to skip is a gate that gets skipped.
timing_note: count(*) on the vaulted index: >2 minutes. Same query on the live SSD index: sub-second.

banded_checksum.method: Aggregate count/sum(chars)/sum(words)/sum(len(preview)) over five 50k-row rowid bands, run identically against the live index and the vault copy. rowid ranges use the primary key index, so each band returns in seconds — unlike the full-table scan, which timed out at ten minutes.
banded_checksum.honest_limit: 0.6% of the table, not a full checksum. Five bands spanning first to last rowid with four independent aggregates each is materially stronger than the three single-row spot checks it replaces, and materially weaker than checksumming 41.5M rows. Corruption confined to an unsampled band would still pass.
